items.label: Mine blocks
items.tooltip: Drag to mark blocks. Shift + wheel changes width; Alt + wheel changes depth. Ctrl removes marks.

items.label: Chop trees
items.tooltip: Click a tree or drag around several to mark them for felling.

items.label: Clear stones
items.tooltip: Click or drag to mark boulders and loose-stone clumps. Workers break boulders or gather scree for rough stone.

items.label: Harvest plants
items.tooltip: Pick ripe berries while keeping the plants for later seasons.

items.label: Clear plants
items.tooltip: Permanently remove shrubs, flowers and reeds. Shrubs yield a cutting; flowers and reeds yield no items.

items.label: Cancel orders
items.tooltip: Click or drag across marked blocks, trees, stones and shrubs to cancel work. Partial progress is kept.

items.label: Stockpile
items.tooltip: Drag over clear, walkable ground to create a storage zone. Select a finished zone to choose accepted goods.

items.label: Dwarves
items.tooltip: Your dwarves, their current work and rest

items.label: Labor
items.tooltip: Manage real dwarf work permissions in the colony roster

items.label: Trade
